project.name: M62 Junction 10–12 Smart Motorway Upgrade – EPC Project
project.description: All-lane-running smart motorway upgrade of ~20 km of the M62 between Junctions 10 and 12, including overbridge replacement, drainage, pavement and smart-motorway technology, delivered EPC for National Highways.
project.goal:
# Highway EPC – UK Smart Motorway / All-Purpose Trunk Road Upgrade

PMO/domain reference — must be reviewed by qualified highway/structural engineers.

## Purpose

This domain pack equips the Agentic PMO Plan, Monitor and Alert agents with a UK-specific reference for delivering a large highway EPC scheme in England (for example an M62 Junction 10–12 Smart Motorway Upgrade, or an A14-class all-purpose trunk road improvement under a DBFO/DPR-type arrangement with National Highways). The goal of such a scheme is to deliver additional capacity and improved journey reliability on the Strategic Road Network (SRN) through an engineered, consenting-compliant and safety-led EPC delivery: all-lane-running smart motorway technology (or trunk road widening), structures renewals, drainage, pavement and technology systems, handed over to the maintainer with a complete as-built and O&M record, on programme and within funding envelope.

risks.title: Utility discovery clashes with TM phasing
risks.description: Live apparatus discovered during excavation clashes with planned TM phasing, forcing re-sequencing.
risks.mitigation: Early utility surveys, trial pits and joint planning with undertakers before TM fixation.

risks.title: Unforeseen ground conditions / contaminated land
risks.description: Ground conditions differ from design assumptions, including contamination or soft ground.
risks.mitigation: Adequate GI coverage, geotechnical risk register and contingency in earthworks method.

risks.title: Ground settlement affects adjacent structures
risks.description: Dewatering, excavation or piling causes settlement affecting adjacent buildings or services.
risks.mitigation: Condition surveys, movement monitoring and settlement control in temporary works.

risks.title: Ecology season constraints delay GCN works
risks.description: Great crested newt, bat and breeding-bird mitigation is season-constrained and works are late.
risks.mitigation: Early surveys and Natural England licence applications; mitigation sequenced to season windows.

risks.title: CPO objections delay land access
risks.description: Objections to compulsory purchase delay vesting and possession of land required for construction.
risks.mitigation: Early engagement with landowners, negotiated acquisition first, robust CPO strategy.

risks.title: Night closure lane rental cost overrun
risks.description: Overrun on night closures under lane-rental incurs charges and erodes contingency.
risks.mitigation: Realistic closure planning, readiness checks, conservative scope per closure.

risks.title: Surfacing weather windows missed
risks.description: The surface course cannot be laid within suitable weather windows.
risks.mitigation: Programme surfacing into season, weather-watch and contingency days.

risks.title: Public Inquiry prolongation / DCO delay
risks.description: A Public Inquiry or examination extends the consenting timetable.
risks.mitigation: Strong pre-application engagement and proactive inquiry preparation.

risks.title: BIM/DMRB compliance gaps
risks.description: Designs or the information model fail to meet DMRB or BIM Level 2 requirements.
risks.mitigation: Compliance checking at design gates, EIR clarity and BIM management.

risks.title: Traffic diverge/merge safety near site works
risks.description: Diverge/merge layouts near live works create collision risk.
risks.mitigation: TM designed to standard, safety inspections and RSA at gates.

risks.title: Steel price escalation on structures
risks.description: Structural steel price escalation increases structures cost above estimate.
risks.mitigation: Early ordering, fixed-price agreements and value engineering.

risks.title: As-built survey data incomplete
risks.description: As-built survey information is incomplete at handover.
risks.mitigation: Survey-as-you-go, CDE enforcement and milestone checks.

risks.title: Long-lead gantry/VMS delivery delay
risks.description: Gantries and VMS arrive late, deferring technology installation and commissioning.
risks.mitigation: Early orders, factory acceptance tests and supplier surveillance.

risks.title: MIDAS/HSR integration software defects
risks.description: Smart-motorway integration reveals software defects delaying commissioning.
risks.mitigation: Early interface definition, factory testing and staged integration.

risks.title: Asphalt plant capacity / bitumen supply
risks.description: Asphalt plant capacity or bitumen supply constrains the surfacing programme.
risks.mitigation: Secure plant allocation, alternate suppliers and tonnage scheduling.

risks.title: Piling refusal / obstructions
risks.description: Piling encounters refusal or obstructions not anticipated in design.
risks.mitigation: Adequate GI, pile trial and obstructions protocol.

risks.title: Drainage outfall flooding / discharge consent
risks.description: Outfall capacity or discharge-consent conditions constrain drainage.
risks.mitigation: Early engagement with LLFA and Environment Agency.

risks.title: HV cable strike during excavation
risks.description: Striking an HV cable during excavation causes serious injury or outage.
risks.mitigation: Permit to dig, CAT/GPR scanning, hand-dig zones, cable-avoidance training.

risks.title: Night-time working fatigue / incident
risks.description: Fatigue from repeated night shifts increases incident likelihood.
risks.mitigation: Roster controls, fatigue management and welfare provision.

risks.title: VRS non-conformance / wrong system spec
risks.description: An installed VRS does not match the certified system or containment required.
risks.mitigation: Certified product procurement, installation inspection, impact-certification checks.

risks.title: Late design change (scope creep)
risks.description: Late design changes in construction cause rework, delay and cost growth.
risks.mitigation: Robust change control, design freeze at gates, early client decisions.

risks.title: Inflation / interest rate impact on funding
risks.description: Construction inflation and interest-rate movements erode the funding envelope.
risks.mitigation: Forecast monitoring, hedging where applicable, value engineering.

risks.title: Stakeholder objection / political delay
risks.description: Political or stakeholder opposition delays consents or approvals.
risks.mitigation: Proactive stakeholder engagement and clear communications.

risks.title: Archaeology finds causing delays
risks.description: Significant archaeological finds during works halt progress in an area.
risks.mitigation: Desk-based assessment, evaluation trenching and agreed mitigation in advance.

risks.title: Weather disruption days exceeding allowance
risks.description: Weather disruption days exceed the programme allowance.
risks.mitigation: Seasonal planning, weather-watch and resilient methods.

risks.title: Subcontractor insolvency / capacity
risks.description: A key subcontractor becomes insolvent or lacks capacity.
risks.mitigation: Prequalification, financial checks and dual-sourcing critical packages.

risks.title: Pavement quality non-conformance / rework
risks.description: Pavement layers fail compaction or materials testing, requiring rework.
risks.mitigation: Method statements, plant calibration and in-situ testing.

risks.title: Concrete curing delays (cold weather)
risks.description: Cold-weather concreting causes curing delays.
risks.mitigation: Cold-weather method, insulation and accelerated mixes.

risks.title: Lighting electrical energisation delay
risks.description: Lighting energisation slips due to supply or electrical-completion issues.
risks.mitigation: Early cable/equipment procurement and commissioning tracking.

risks.title: Traffic modelling underestimate
risks.description: Traffic modelling underestimates demand, prompting late design change.
risks.mitigation: Robust model validation and independent assurance.

risks.title: Land compensation cost escalation
risks.description: Land compensation and disturbance costs exceed provision.
risks.mitigation: Early valuation, negotiated settlement and expert support.

risks.title: Section 278 agreement delay with local authority
risks.description: S278 agreement negotiation with a local authority slips, affecting programme.
risks.mitigation: Early engagement and pre-agreed technical basis.

monitoring_alerts.message: Public Inquiry milestone slipped > 30 days; consent critical path at risk.
GCN mitigation season window closing; Natural England licence application late.
Critical-path HV utility diversion slippage exceeds 14 days.
Steel erection on Bridge 4 behind plan by > 10% (62% vs 78%).
Lane-rental budget consumed above 80% before completion of TM.
Surfacing weather window missed; final surfacing re-sequenced.
Pavement compaction test failure rate above 5% on lot 12.
CPO land not fully vested before Phase 5 works on plot 17.
Smart motorway MIDAS integration test failures recorded.
CPI below 0.94 for two periods; cost pressure flagged.
Near-miss frequency rising on night shifts; fatigue review launched.
Snagging closure rate 55%, below 60% approaching Stage 3 audit.

EIA scoping opinion received; design feed initiated.
Lane 3 closure TM plan flagged for risk: diverge taper non-compliant.
Bridge 4 steel erection at 62% vs 78% plan; recovery plan requested.
Critical: GCN ecology season window closing – mitigation late.
Public Inquiry ADJOURNED – reschedule risk to DCO determination.
Pavement surfacing weather window missed (2.4 days lost); final surfacing re-sequenced.
Long-lead structural steel ordered early to protect critical path.
CPI tracking 0.94; steel and bitumen escalation noted.
VRS non-conformance raised; batch quarantined pending certification.
CPO objection received on plot 17; vesting route assessed.
Near-miss frequency rising on night shifts; fatigue review launched and closed.
